rollback.note: First R2 release; the earlier version was Hub-hosted. Reverting the migration commit redeploys the Hub-hosted version; the immutable R2 objects stay.

changes: Rewritten from the Hub-hosted legacy version (ExpFactory jsPsych or Pixi reference game) into a self-contained R2 package with its own settings dialog, spotlight tutorial, results and zh/en copy; settings.json, score.json, public/runtime and the OfficialGameShell dependency are gone and the old Hub sub-assets return 410
Original stimulus time and trial count kept
Practice can be turned off in settings
